description: Creates a rank tracker config (domain + market + devices + schedule) for a project and returns its configId. Next, add keywords with add_rank_tracking_keywords. Positions are collected by the SCHEDULED check ('daily' or 'weekly'; 'manual' means never on a schedule) and read with get_rank_tracker — nothing here triggers a check on demand. One tracker per (domain, market) per project: repeating a pair is a validation error, not a second tracker. FREE at creation: database only, no credits spent.

competitorMoveAlertThreshold.description: Notify when a tracked competitor gains at least this many positions. null turns it off.

domain.description: Domain whose positions are tracked, e.g. example.com.

languageCode.description: Language code (e.g. 'en'). Omit it to use the project's default market language.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Omit it to use the project's default market.

locationHint.description: Free-text city/region hint, honoured only where the SERP provider supports it.

newKeywordAlertEnabled.description: Notify when the domain starts ranking for a keyword it did not rank for before.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

rankDropAlertThreshold.description: Notify when a keyword falls by at least this many positions. null turns it off.

scheduleInterval.description: How often the scheduled check runs.

serpDepth.description: How deep to search, 10-100 in steps of 10.

name: create_rank_tracker
